name: 86 Chaos 16.0.70 Global Refresh and Login Loop Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.70 Global Refresh and Login Loop Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.70 Global Refresh and Login Loop Fix
notes: Global refresh now writes both workspace and user refresh signals so active clients reload reliably.
Employees are protected from stale force-logout flags causing repeated login loops.
User session listeners now handle refresh/logout signals without requiring users to clear browser data.
